title: AATM entity definitions
description: A list of entities to extract from clinical notes, and optionally how each one becomes a row of an OMOP CDM table. See https://precisiondata.github.io/aatm/latest/getting-started/entity_definitions/

AttributeDefinition.description:
A classification attached to each mention of an entity, e.g. the result of a test.

The model picks one label per attribute, based on what the note states about that
mention. It is not a span: the label does not have to appear in the text.

key.description: The key of the attribute, e.g. `"result"`. Unique within the entity.
key.markdownDescription: The key of the attribute, e.g. `"result"`. Unique within the entity.

description.description: What the attribute describes. The model reads it.
description.markdownDescription: What the attribute describes. The model reads it.

required.description: If True, a mention without a valid label for this attribute is rejected. If False (default), the mention is kept without the attribute.
required.markdownDescription: If True, a mention without a valid label for this attribute is rejected. If False (default), the mention is kept without the attribute.

ordered.description: Whether the labels form a scale, listed lowest first, e.g. the ECOG grades 0 to 5. A decision model then answers a score question, which knows that 2 lies between 1 and 3, instead of a choice question (see `aatm.extractors.DecisionAttributeLabeller`). The extractor's prompt does not use it.
ordered.markdownDescription: Whether the labels form a scale, listed lowest first, e.g. the ECOG grades 0 to 5. A decision model then answers a score question, which knows that 2 lies between 1 and 3, instead of a choice question (see `aatm.extractors.DecisionAttributeLabeller`). The extractor's prompt does not use it.

AttributeDefinition.markdownDescription:
A classification attached to each mention of an entity, e.g. the result of a test.

The model picks one label per attribute, based on what the note states about that
mention. It is not a span: the label does not have to appear in the text.

AttributeLabel.description: One allowed value of an attribute.

value.description: The label, e.g. `"positive"`. This is what the model returns.
value.markdownDescription: The label, e.g. `"positive"`. This is what the model returns.

description.description: When this label applies. The model reads it.
description.markdownDescription: When this label applies. The model reads it.

AttributeLabel.markdownDescription: One allowed value of an attribute.

ConceptRef.description: A concept identified by its vocabulary and code, e.g. `SNOMED:423740007`.
ConceptRef.markdownDescription: A concept identified by its vocabulary and code, e.g. `SNOMED:423740007`.

key.description: The key of the entity. If not provided, the name will be used with all letters lowercased and spaces replaced by underscores.
key.markdownDescription: The key of the entity. If not provided, the name will be used with all letters lowercased and spaces replaced by underscores.

has_parent.description: Whether extracted spans of this entity must reference a parent span.
has_parent.markdownDescription: Whether extracted spans of this entity must reference a parent span.

parent_key.description: The key of the parent entity. Required when `has_parent` is True.
parent_key.markdownDescription: The key of the parent entity. Required when `has_parent` is True.

attributes.description: Classifications the model assigns to each mention of this entity, e.g. the result of a test.
attributes.markdownDescription: Classifications the model assigns to each mention of this entity, e.g. the result of a test.

omop.description: How each mention becomes a row of an OMOP CDM table, see `aatm.omop.mapping`. Never sent to the model.
omop.markdownDescription: How each mention becomes a row of an OMOP CDM table, see `aatm.omop.mapping`. Never sent to the model.

FieldSource.description:
Where one column's value comes from: `from`, `value` or `concept`.

See `aatm.omop.mapping` for examples.

from.description: Where in the note the value comes from: `text` (the mention), `attribute.<key>` (the label of an attribute), `child.<key>` (the text of the first child mention with that key) or `context.<name>` (a value given with the note, e.g. `context.person_id`). Use exactly one of `from`, `value` and `concept`.
from.markdownDescription: Where in the note the value comes from: `text` (the mention), `attribute.<key>` (the label of an attribute), `child.<key>` (the text of the first child mention with that key) or `context.<name>` (a value given with the note, e.g. `context.person_id`). Use exactly one of `from`, `value` and `concept`.

value.description: A fixed value, e.g. the type concept id `32858` (NLP).
value.markdownDescription: A fixed value, e.g. the type concept id `32858` (NLP).

concept.description: A concept written as `<VOCABULARY>:<code>`, e.g. `"SNOMED:423740007"`. The column gets its concept id, looked up in the local OMOP vocabulary database.
concept.markdownDescription: A concept written as `<VOCABULARY>:<code>`, e.g. `"SNOMED:423740007"`. The column gets its concept id, looked up in the local OMOP vocabulary database.

concepts.description: With `from: attribute.<key>`, the concept of each label, e.g. `{positive: "SNOMED:10828004"}`. The column gets the concept id instead of the label.
concepts.markdownDescription: With `from: attribute.<key>`, the concept of each label, e.g. `{positive: "SNOMED:10828004"}`. The column gets the concept id instead of the label.

maps_to.description: Replace the concept by the standard concept it maps to ("Maps to"), as the CDM requires for `*_concept_id` columns. Needs `concept` or `concepts`.
maps_to.markdownDescription: Replace the concept by the standard concept it maps to ("Maps to"), as the CDM requires for `*_concept_id` columns. Needs `concept` or `concepts`.

map.description: Code the text with the terminology mapper (translation, retrieval, reranking, selection), e.g. `{domain: Measurement, min_score: 0.8}`.
map.markdownDescription: Code the text with the terminology mapper (translation, retrieval, reranking, selection), e.g. `{domain: Measurement, min_score: 0.8}`.

lookup.description: Find the text as a code of this vocabulary, e.g. `UCUM` for the unit `"mg/dL"`.
lookup.markdownDescription: Find the text as a code of this vocabulary, e.g. `UCUM` for the unit `"mg/dL"`.

as.description: Convert the value: `int`, `float`, `str`, `date` (parsed from text such as "March 2024") or `days` (a duration such as "2 weeks", as a number of days).
as.markdownDescription: Convert the value: `int`, `float`, `str`, `date` (parsed from text such as "March 2024") or `days` (a duration such as "2 weeks", as a number of days).

period_start.description: A date column listed before this one. The value is a number of days N, and this column gets that date plus N - 1 days: the end of an N-day period.
period_start.markdownDescription: A date column listed before this one. The value is a number of days N, and this column gets that date plus N - 1 days: the end of an N-day period.

when.description: Use this source only for mentions whose attribute has one of these labels, e.g. `{attribute.status: [current]}`; otherwise the next source is tried.
when.markdownDescription: Use this source only for mentions whose attribute has one of these labels, e.g. `{attribute.status: [current]}`; otherwise the next source is tried.

FieldSource.markdownDescription:
Where one column's value comes from: `from`, `value` or `concept`.

See `aatm.omop.mapping` for examples.

MapSpec.description: How to code a text with the terminology mapper.

vocabularies.description: Optionally, only retrieve from these vocabularies, e.g. `["LOINC"]`. By default every indexed vocabulary is searched: what a `*_concept_id` column requires is a standard concept, not a vocabulary.
vocabularies.markdownDescription: Optionally, only retrieve from these vocabularies, e.g. `["LOINC"]`. By default every indexed vocabulary is searched: what a `*_concept_id` column requires is a standard concept, not a vocabulary.

domain.description: Domain to retrieve from, e.g. `"Measurement"`. Defaults to the domain the column requires.
domain.markdownDescription: Domain to retrieve from, e.g. `"Measurement"`. Defaults to the domain the column requires.

min_score.description: Mappings with a lower confidence score are stored as `0` (an unmapped value, as the CDM asks) and reported.
min_score.markdownDescription: Mappings with a lower confidence score are stored as `0` (an unmapped value, as the CDM asks) and reported.

MapSpec.markdownDescription: How to code a text with the terminology mapper.
